description: Pins serialize_vault_meta_v0_2 + parse_vault_meta_v0_2 (NTV5). Identical 345-byte layout to MYV1 with bytes [0..5] swapped to magic NTV5 + protocol_version 0x02 — the 0x02 side of the frozen §10.4.1 md.6 split. The two reject cases are the load-bearing ones: §10.5 anti-downgrade means a MYV1 blob must not parse as v0.2 and an NTV5 blob must not parse as v0.1, which a round-trip alone would not catch in an implementation that ignored the magic. Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_vault_meta_v0_2_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored --nocapture`.

cases.description: Hand-crafted fixture, byte patterns 0x5A..0x63 (distinct from the v0.1 category's 0xDA..0xE3 so a cross-category diff cannot show one set for the other). FAST_TEST_KDF params.
§10.5 anti-downgrade: the SAME fields serialized as MYV1 must be rejected by the v0.2 parser. Bytes [5..] are byte-identical to the roundtrip case, so only the magic + version separate them.
The other direction: a v0.1 client must refuse an NTV5 blob rather than half-parse it (§10.5, the fleet safety gate for a cut-over vault reached by an un-upgraded client).

An NTV5 vault.meta with no membership field: 345 bytes, reserved byte 0x00. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it and report membership: None (unmigrated). Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_membership_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored --nocapture`.

An NTV5 vault.meta with the membership field present: 417 bytes, reserved byte 0x01, a 16-byte account id sealed under membership_key (root_key = 0x11.., account_number_hash = 0x44.., nonce = 0xCD..). parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it and unseal_membership must recover the account id.
The membership-present blob with the first ciphertext byte flipped. unseal_membership must fail closed (AeadFailure), never a partial read.

An NTV5 vault.meta with the B2B roster extension: reserved byte 0x02, 417 + 24 + 4 + N bytes, the roster envelope (nonce 0xEE.., u32 BE length, ciphertext) after the 72 single-account bytes, sealed under membership_key with the roster AAD. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it and unseal_membership_roster must recover the roster plaintext under root_key = 0x11.., account_number_hash = 0x44..
The roster-present blob with the middle roster ciphertext byte flipped. unseal_membership_roster must fail closed (AeadFailure), never a partial read.

The roster-present blob with the u32 BE ciphertext-length field pushed past the 64 KiB cap. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must reject the length BEFORE reading any ciphertext (InvalidVaultMeta), so the cap is enforced at the frame layer.

An NTV5 vault.meta with a real two-row canonical roster (owner + member) carrying the vault role field: the owner row spells role owner, the member row omits the default, sealed under membership_key with the roster AAD. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it and unseal_membership_roster must recover the exact plaintext under root_key = 0x11.., account_number_hash = 0x44..

An NTV5 vault.meta with ONLY the person binding field: reserved byte 0x10 (the independent bit), 345 base bytes + 72 binding bytes. parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it, report membership: None and unseal the person id hash. A vault may be bound to an identity with no account membership.

The person binding combined with the membership field: reserved byte 0x11 (membership shape bits 0x01 OR the binding bit 0x10). The binding is written after the membership bytes, so its position is determined by the low bits and the bit only says it is there.
The binding-only blob with the first binding ciphertext byte flipped. unseal_person_binding must fail closed (AeadFailure), never a partial read.
A pre-feature NTV5 vault.meta (reserved byte 0x00, no binding). parse_vault_meta_v0_2 must accept it and report person_binding: None, so an old vault reads as unbound rather than failing.
